result.summary: The food delivery home screen is generally well-designed and functional. A few minor visual/layout issues were found, mainly around horizontal carousel content being clipped at the right edge without clear scroll affordance, and a promotional badge that may be misleading.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge, truncating the restaurant name mid-word with no visible scroll indicator or fade-out hint.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or partial-card peek with consistent padding so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, and ensure card text truncates with an ellipsis rather than cutting mid-word.

issues.description: The '-100%' discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card is ambiguous and potentially misleading, as a 100% discount implies the item is free, which may not reflect the actual offer.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the badge wording (e.g., 'Free item', '100% off delivery', or the specific promotion) so users understand the actual deal.

issues.description: The category filter chips ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) and the 'See all' links rely on color alone in some states, and the heart/favorite icons on cards have no visible text labels, which can be unclear for screen reader and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (aria-label) to icon-only buttons such as the notification bell and favorite hearts, and ensure selected/unselected chip states differ by more than color (e.g., border or weight).
